blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — A tropical depression may enter the Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR) on Thursday morning or afternoon, September 24, the state weather bureau said. As of 3 a.m. Wednesday, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) located the tropical depression 1,920 kilometers east of Southern Luzon. It was moving northwestward at 25 kilometers per hour, with maximum sustained winds of 55 kph near the center and gusts of up to 70 kph.
